ctx.x: Fletcher Henderson's house. (something about Russell Lewis and Joe's brother, first trumpet player with the band) So this particular day I was pretty good chops ... and that was, a lot of good guys in the band you might remember... brass section, Russell, Red and me, Russell playing first, I was playing second and Red was playing third. Hilton Jefferson playing first alto, Procope, Buster Bailey, Coleman Hawkins, Russell Toco (?) ... Walter Johnson, John Kirby and Horace Henderson.
And the trombones were who, Claude?
